dataset: CIFAR-100 (python version; indices refer to the official train / test splits, as in torchvision.datasets.CIFAR100)
procedure: ID train-split images of the 4 ID classes, shuffled with numpy RandomState(seed); first 90% = train, rest = eval (cap 800). Each OOD class = all its test-split images followed by all its train-split images (600 <= cap 800, so no subsampling).
